skill.summary: 1688 店铺经营健康诊断 —— 全面诊断店铺经营健康状况。 工具能力：核心指标对比同行同层、流量结构分析、行业交易排名、客户画像分析，自动识别瓶颈并给出改善建议。 触发词：店铺诊断、经营诊断、健康诊断、店铺分析、经营分析、店铺健康。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of 1688-shop-operate: provides comprehensive health diagnostics for 1688 store operation.
- Supports core metric comparison with peers, traffic structure analysis, industry transaction ranking (7/30 days only), and customer profile analysis.
- Secure AK management system: supports device-bound local encryption and detailed CLI commands for safe key handling.
- All diagnostics are executed via CLI commands with markdown output; agents perform result analysis and reporting without fabricating data.
- Modular, markdown-based diagnostic report template with HTML comments for better UI integration and data segmentation.
- Includes clear error/data handling rules and interactive guidance for further user analysis after diagnostics.
